results.title: Austria vs France Prediction: Euro 2024 Match Preview | Opta Analyst
highlights:
We look ahead to this Euro 2024 Group D clash in Düsseldorf with our Austria vs France prediction and preview.
[...]
- Austria only lost once in Euro 2024 qualifying, winning six of their eight games.
- Kylian Mbappé is yet to score for France at a European Championship.
- France are expected to start their Euro 2024 campaign with a win. The Opta supercomputer rates their victory chances at 65.8% against Austria.
- Explainers
[...]
One of the favourites to win the tournament, France get their Euro 2024 campaign under way when they face Austria in Düsseldorf on Monday.
[...]
Ralf Rangnick’s side impressed in qualifying, losing just once in their eight games (W6 D1) as they finished second to Belgium in their group, with the Red Devils the only team to beat them. They could be one of the dark horses at this summer’s tournament.
[...]
highest expected assists total
[...]
France eased through their qualifying group, topping it with seven wins from eight games (D1). Nearly half of Les Bleus’ 29 goals in qualifying came in one match – a 14-0 win against Gibraltar in November, which was the biggest margin of victory ever in a Euros qualifying match.
[...]
All eyes will be on Kylian Mbappé at Euro 2024, fresh off recent confirmation of his move to Real Madrid. Mbappé has scored 12 goals for France at major tournaments, though all of those have come at the World Cup. He has never scored at a Euros, failing to convert any of his 14 shots at Euro 2020. He also missed his spot kick in the shootout defeat against Switzerland in the round of 16. The bad news for France is that the forward missed training on Thursday with a virus, so might miss out for the opening game.
[...]
Should France win Euro 2024, it will make Deschamps the first person to win the World Cup and European Championship both as player and manager. Ronald Koeman will be the only other manager at this summer’s tournament who previously won the Euros as a player (1988).
[...]
This will be the third meeting between Austria and France at a major tournament. They have one victory each, with Austria winning 3-2 at the 1934 World Cup, while France succeeded 1-0 in the 1982 World Cup.
[...]
## Austria vs France Prediction
[...]
France are expected to begin their Euro 2024 campaign with three points according to the Opta supercomputer, which backs Les Bleus to win in 65.8% of scenarios.
[...]
Austria won just 15.5% of simulations, while the teams could not be separated in the remaining 18.7%.
[...]
France are heavy favourites to win the group, finishing top in 57.9% of sims, while they advance to the knockout rounds 92.9% of the time. Austria only finish first in 9.8% of sims, but have a 51.1% likelihood of making it to the knockouts.

results.title: Austria vs France: Preview, predictions and lineups
highlights:
Austria vs France: Preview, predictions and lineups
[...]
France have been handed a difficult start to their Euro 2024 campaign as they face in-form Austria on Monday evening.
[...]
However, their last 16 exit at the hands of Switzerland at Euro 2020 highlights that nothing can be taken for granted, especially given the calibre of their group stage opponents. While it's extremely unlikely that France won't make it to the knockout stages, Poland, Austria and the Netherlands will prove formidable foes.
[...]
Austria could well provide the sternest challenge to the 2018 world champions as they head into the tournament having lost just one of their last 16 matches. Victories against Italy and Germany show that Austria, now led by former Manchester United manager Ralf Rangnick, are not at Euro 2024 to simply make up the numbers.
[...]

[...]
Austria predicted lineup (4-2-3-1): Pentz; Mwene, Danso, Wober, Posch; Seiwald, Laimer; Baumgartner, Sabitzer, Schmid; Gregoritsch.
[...]
France's squad depth heading into the tournament is truly sensational, even without the injured Lucas Hernandez and Wesley Fofana. Lucas' brother Theo Hernandez is also an injury doubt for the opener with Austria after coming off at half-time against Canada in the most recent friendly, while Aurelien Tchouameni may not recover in time for Monday's game.
[...]
Premier League fans may be surprised by the fact that William Saliba will take residence on the bench against Austria, with Ibrahima Konate and Dayot Upamecano the preferred partnership at centre-back. Antoine Griezmann should thrive in his midfield role and N'Golo Kante is back in the squad despite now playing in Saudi Arabia.
[...]
France also boast a devastating attack, with Kylian Mbappe - now a Real Madrid player - the main star. Marcus Thuram and Bradley Barcola enter the tournament in excellent form, both winning their respective league titles with Inter and Paris Saint-Germain.
[...]
France predicted lineup (4-3-3): Maignan; Kounde, Konate, Upamecano, Mendy; Griezmann, Camavinga, Rabiot; Dembele, Thuram, Mbappe.
[...]
## Score prediction
[...]
There is no doubt that France will be the favourites for all three of their group stage fixtures but Austria could catch them off guard. Les Bleus put in a tepid performance in a goalless draw with Canada in their final pre-tournament friendly, with such sloppiness likely to be punished by Rangnick's side.
[...]
However, you simply can't bet against this France team. They are stacked with superstars in every area of the pitch, with no obvious weakness in any specific position. They should kick their tournament off with victory.
[...]
### Prediction: Austria 1-2 France

highlights:
## Austria vs France Odds
[...]

| --- | --- |
| France Odds | -182 |

| Over / Under |
[...]
France and Austria will open their tournaments with a crucial match in Group D.
[...]
After losing on penalties in the 2022 World Cup final, France is out for redemption at the Euros, looking to win its first major international trophy since the 2018 World Cup. They are the second favorites behind England and have the best player in the world in Kylian Mbappe, but this is a tricky first match for them in what will be a difficult group.
[...]
Austria comes into the Euros after an impressive qualifying campaign under Ralf Rangnick. They finished second to Belgium in their qualfying group, but the underlying numbers were incredibly impressive. They are set up incredibly well to play as the underdog and will give France a lot of fits both in and out of possession.
[...]
France is a really unique team in the fact that is not interested in controlling or holding a majority of the possession in a match. They want to try to get in transition as often as they possibly can. That worked throughout qualifying against the Netherlands because they let them have the ball and created a lot of transition opportunities. Where they had some struggles were against teams that played very compact low blocks.
[...]
They also did not face a team that pressed or won duels at the rate Austria does. Rangnick is not going to have his side press recklessly, but if they do force France into long balls out of build-up moments, they allowed the third-lowest long ball completion percentage and had the highest duel win rate of anyone in the Euro field during qualifiers.
[...]
Of course, France has Mbappe and all of the attacking talent in the world, so they are a team that can blitz you at a moments notice, but consistently losing duels all over the pitch makes them an overvalued favorite.
[...]
France is one of the favorites in this tournament for a reason. They have way more talent than just about every team in this field, but being so reliant on trying to play direct has come back to bite them in years past. They also have been facing a ton of low defensive blocks throughout qualifying and haven't faced a mid-to-high block pressing team like Austria.
[...]
Austria is a really underrated team in this tournament. Being good out of possession, winning duels and hurting teams in transition is vital if you want to pull off an upset as an underdog — and they have all three.
[...]
France may very well win with their quality, but they are overvalued in this first match. I only have them projected at -153, so I like the value on Austria +1 at -105.
[...]
#### Pick: Austria +1 (-105 via bet365)
